intro: Upload the device list as a CSV file. A dry run shows what would be created or changed and lists every error. Nothing is saved until you choose “Apply”.

format.heading: Expected format
format.header: The first line holds exactly these 13 columns, in this order:
format.optionalColumn: A 14th column may follow at the end; then every row has 14 values:
format.deviceClassValues: It holds the device class, one of these values:
format.deviceClassEmpty: Without this column, or with an empty value, a new device gets the class other and an existing device keeps its class. An unknown value is an error.
format.encoding: UTF-8, columns separated by commas, values with commas or line breaks in double quotes.
format.matching: Plants are matched by plant_id, devices by device_id. Existing entries are updated, new ones created, nothing is deleted.
format.plantRow: A row without device_id describes only the plant; it may fill notes, but no device column.
format.allOrNothing: If one row has an error, nothing is saved.

report.heading: Result
report.dryRun_one: Dry run: nothing has been saved yet. {{count}} row read.
report.dryRun_other: Dry run: nothing has been saved yet. {{count}} rows read.
report.hasErrors_one: The file has {{count}} error. Nothing has been saved.
report.hasErrors_other: The file has {{count}} errors. Nothing has been saved.
report.fixAndRetry: Correct the file and start the dry run again.
report.readyToSave: No errors found. Choose “Apply” to save these changes.

problem.invalid: The server did not accept the upload.
problem.tooLarge: The file is larger than the server accepts.
